🚇 One day on the Vienna U-Bahn — Thursday 22 October 2026.

2,890 trains on lines U1, U2, U3, U4 and U6, crossing the Danube and circling the old city. Each dot is a scheduled train on the real track, in its line colour. Morning peak: 113 trains on the move at 07:27.
